title: Marketing Intel Source Output
description: Standardized output format that every source plugin must produce. Each source outputs a JSON object with metadata and a data section containing metrics, trends, and anomalies.

source.description: Source identifier matching the filename without extension (e.g. 'ga4', 'gsc', 'zoho_salesiq')

mode.description: Collection mode: 'weekly' for full report data, 'anomaly' for change-detection only

start.description: ISO date, start of reporting window

end.description: ISO date, end of reporting window

comparison_start.description: ISO date, start of comparison window (previous period)

comparison_end.description: ISO date, end of comparison window

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this data was collected

error.description: If the source failed to collect data, describe the error here. Data section may be empty or partial.

data.description: Source-specific data payload. Structure varies by source but should include the sections relevant to the source type.

summary.description: High-level metrics for the period with period-over-period deltas

change_pct.description: Percentage change from previous to current

top_items.description: Top N items by the source's primary metric (pages, queries, campaigns, etc.)

trends.description: Notable trends: items gaining or losing momentum

anomalies.description: Statistically significant deviations from expected values

dimension.description: What the anomaly applies to (page, query, campaign, etc.)
